verdict_detail: REJECTED at the pre-registered primary gate. Variant (b) is structurally inert at its registered knee (cannot change top-25 membership; gap byte-identical). Variant (a) at the only workable knee (display-55 boundary, raw 52.5) fails in every FITTED operationalization: isotonic-anchored gap 3.89 (share 0.33), Theil-Sen linear gap 4.38 (WIDENS; share 0.35), OLS degenerate (pit slope -0.02 -> identity), pure unanchored 3.18 (share 0.38), rank_war crosswalk 4.09 (share 0.41). The gate-passing s=0.04-0.05 shrink exists but is un-fitted, knife-edged (0.02-wide window) and single-player-lucky -- shipping it would be gate-tuning. ROOT CAUSE: above the display-55 knee, pitcher display grades carry no realized-WAR gradient (OLS -0.02, Theil-Sen +0.18 with LOFO ratio range 0.05-0.70, isotonic curve = one thin-cell jump). No monotone relabeling of an outcome-flat tail can honestly close a gap that is driven by WHICH pitchers reach the tail, not by what number they wear.
path_forward: The parity target is real and already achieved by the raw rank_war frame (top-25 pit share 0.13, gap 1.75, CI90 [-1.29, 4.68] covers 0). The skew is a display-map CONSTRUCTION artifact: per-side quantile mapping re-inflates pit tail share 2.47x (F-SIDE share_inflation_display_vs_raw). The honest instrument is a JOINT cross-side quantile display map above the knee (one pooled consensus-FV target, ranked by cross-side rank_war) -- but that changes HITTER display grades too, violating this decision's S2/byte-identity constraints, so it needs a new owner registration. Alternatively wait for resolved 2024+ folds to give the pit tail curves real support.
